full_prompt_en: The image is a square, poster-like graphic collage of dark-clad armed figures advancing before a crowded background, dominated by saturated red and black. A broad red diagonal plane cuts from the upper left toward the lower right, splitting the composition into a comparatively open left field and a dense upper-right mass. The red surface carries scratches, faded print marks, and uneven mottling rather than a perfectly flat digital fill. In the upper right, many small helmeted figures overlap in several rows. Their faces, shoulders, and long narrow weapons are rendered in red-black tonal relief, receding into a wall of repeated forms. Triangular dark red shapes rise behind the crowd, reinforcing the sharp upward and forward rhythm. In the foreground, three larger figures in gray-black jackets and caps lean toward the center from opposite sides. The left figure is cropped by the edge and bends forward with an arm extending inward. A smaller middle figure crouches with a long weapon angled up from the lower center. On the right, another figure bends toward them with both hands gripping a long dark object, so several diagonals converge near the bottom middle. Faces are partly shadowed by their caps, and the exact expressions remain secondary to the forceful body angles. Fine engrained texture and deep black shadows model the jackets and limbs, separating them from the red plane without introducing bright color. Light appears as a graphic lift on the upper planes of caps, shoulders, and hands rather than a natural scene-wide source. The background crowd is smaller and more compressed, while the foreground bodies are almost sculptural, creating depth through scale and tonal weight. There is no legible slogan or text in this selected panel. The overall composition is urgent and confrontational, built from a limited red-black palette, repeated silhouettes, and converging diagonal action.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形、海报式图形拼贴：深衣持械人物在拥挤背景前推进，画面由饱和红与黑主导。一道宽阔红色斜面从左上切向右下，将构图分成相对开放的左侧色域与浓密的右上群像。红色表面带有划痕、褪色印刷印记和不均匀斑驳，并非完美平坦的数字填色。右上方，许多戴帽人影在数排中相互重叠。面孔、肩膀和细长器物以红黑调子浮雕般描绘，向后退成重复形体之墙。深红三角形在队列后升起，强化尖锐向上、向前的节奏。前景，三名较大的灰黑人物穿外套戴帽，从两侧向中央俯身。左侧人物被画边裁切，前弯并将一臂向内伸出。较小的中央人物蹲伏，长形器物从下方中央斜上。右侧另一人也朝他们俯身，双手握着深色长物，因此几道斜线在下方中央汇合。帽檐使面孔局部留暗，具体表情次于有力的身体角度。细密嵌入的纹理与深黑阴影塑造外套和四肢，让其从红色平面中分离，却不引入鲜亮杂色。光表现为帽子、肩和手的朝上平面被图形化提亮，而非整个场景统一的自然光源。背景队列更小、更压缩，前景身体则近乎雕塑，纵深由尺度和调子重量建立。这一选定画面没有可读口号或文字。整体构图紧迫且有对抗感，由有限的红黑色谱、重复剪影和汇聚的斜向动作组成。
style_prompt_en: A poster-like graphic collage uses saturated red against heavy charcoal-black tonal modeling. Large hard-edged diagonal areas organize the frame, while dense small repeated marks and figures form a darker secondary texture. Selective gray highlights lift the nearest shapes from flat red fields, creating sculptural weight without a broad color range. Scratches, grain, and imperfect printed mottling keep the surface tactile. Depth comes from scale changes, overlapping silhouettes, and increasing density rather than soft atmospheric perspective. Oblique lines converge toward a compact focal zone, generating forward pressure and urgency. Light is graphic and selective, catching upper planes while recesses remain nearly black. The overall effect is forceful, compressed, and immediately readable, with stark palette and directional rhythm carrying the visual language.
style_prompt_zh: 这种海报式图形拼贴以饱和红色对照厚重炭黑色的调子塑形。大片硬边斜面组织画幅，浓密细小的重复印记与形体形成较深的次级纹理。选择性的灰色亮部将最近的形状从平面红域中提起，不需宽阔色谱也有雕塑重量。划痕、颗粒和不完美的印刷斑驳使表面可触。纵深来自尺度变化、剪影遮叠与密度增加，而非柔软的大气透视。倾斜线条向紧凑焦点区域汇聚，产生向前压迫感与紧迫节奏。光具有图形化和选择性，照到上方面，凹处仍近乎黑色。整体效果有力、压缩且易于立即识别，强烈的有限色谱与方向节奏构成视觉语言。

theme_zh: 深衣持械人物在密集人群与巨大红色斜面前推进
name: Propaganda art
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
